description: Cotangent/uniform discrete Laplacian over the half-edge mesh + implicit (Desbrun-style) Laplacian smoothing solving (I - lambda*L) x = x0 with faer sparse Cholesky. First real sparse-solve consumer in outram-blender; unblocks op-hzs.9.
title: outram-blender: cotangent Laplacian + Laplacian smoothing (first faer sparse-solve operator)

title: install pandoc or cmark-gfm — the mandated README validation cannot be run
